summary: Fresh official macro evidence: the FOMC held rates at 3.75%-4.00% on October 28, with two voters preferring a 25 bp hike and inflation/geopolitical uncertainty still elevated. XRP ETF flow proxies remain non-comparable: Alpha Finance's five-fund series reports zero flow on Oct 28 and +$90.4M over 30 sessions, while XRP Insights reports -3,132,685 XRP over Oct 26-27 across six spot funds plus BITW and marks Oct 28 provisional. Meanwhile, main's scheduled Coinbase paper trader appended a BTC-USD sell at 11:04:23Z while its open position still has position_product=null. PR #1306 proposes manual-only execution and fail-closed identity checks; exact-head CI and gate passed, but it remains draft/unmerged.

findings.claim: FOMC held target range at 3.75%-4.00% by 10-2 vote; two voters preferred a 25 bp hike
findings.note: Macro event only. No direct XRP price effect is established.

findings.claim: Alpha Finance reports zero XRP ETF flow on Oct 28 and +$90.4M over 30 sessions
findings.note: Five-fund dollar series; Oct 28 close listed as $1.3309. Coverage and cutoff differ from other aggregators.

findings.claim: XRP Insights reports -3,132,685 XRP over Oct 26-27 and marks Oct 28 provisional
findings.note: Six spot funds plus BITW, flow measured as daily holdings changes in XRP units; not directly comparable with Alpha Finance's five-fund dollar series.

findings.claim: Main paper-trading state has a nonzero open position with null product identity
findings.note: Position size 0.012445158497236623; product identity null; average entry 80436.84; trade count 126. State was not changed in this run.

findings.claim: Scheduled paper trader appended a BTC-USD sell of $998 at $80,121.27 and pushed state/log to main
findings.note: Paper-trading only, not real money. Confirms the recurring workflow remains active and state integrity is not protected on main.

findings.claim: PR #1306 proposes manual-only workflow and fail-closed product identity guard
findings.note: Exact-head core CI and fail-closed gate passed. Draft/unmerged; main continues scheduled runs until approval and merge.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The rate hold may support near-term risk appetite, while hawkish dissents, elevated inflation and geopolitical uncertainty may offset that support; net XRP impact is ambiguous.
disconfirming_evidence: XRP may be dominated over the relevant horizon by crypto-specific flows, leverage, liquidity and regulatory events rather than the rate decision.
tests_needed: Timestamp the announcement; measure XRP and matched crypto/FX/rates responses over pre-registered horizons; compare against BTC and broad risk proxies with event-study controls.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The apparent ETF-flow discrepancy likely reflects differences in fund universe, units, holdings publication timing and provisional settlement rather than a single contradictory measurement.
disconfirming_evidence: Even after aligning funds and timestamps, the series may disagree due to source errors or issuer corrections.
tests_needed: Reconstruct each fund's daily holdings and shares outstanding from issuer records; normalize XRP and USD units; mark provisional/settled status; retain per-fund rows before aggregation.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Even reconciled ETF flows would be an institutional-demand feature, not proof that flows cause XRP price moves; flows may be reactive or hedged.
disconfirming_evidence: Persistent, time-aligned creations could predict subsequent returns after controlling for market beta and derivatives positioning.
tests_needed: Use leakage-safe lagged flows, matched controls, fixed horizons, walk-forward testing, and compare with a no-flow baseline; record uncertainty and sample size.

macro_events.summary: Target range held at 3.75%-4.00% by 10-2 vote; two dissenters preferred a 25 bp hike; statement cites strong activity, elevated inflation and geopolitical uncertainty.
